title: 送り台と厚み調整板付きの卓上フードスライサー
titleEn: Countertop food slicer with carriage and gauge plate
description: デリカテッセンや飲食店の作業カウンター向けの卓上スライサー模型。部分外周ガードと中央カバーで囲んだ固定円盤、別体の厚み調整板とノブ、レールとスリーブで支えた傾斜送り台、押さえ板とガイド棒、前ハンドル、後部モーター外装、上部小カバーを造形しています。円盤だけではなく、食材を置く空の送り台と支持構造が一式に含まれます。食材、刃の可動・切断能力、衛生・食品接触適合性、電気・機械安全の検証は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.631 × 0.635 × 0.606 m、14,048三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A countertop slicer prop for a delicatessen or restaurant work counter, with a fixed circular disc, partial perimeter guard and center cover, separate thickness gauge plate and knob, inclined empty carriage supported by a rail and sleeve, food-pusher face and guide bar, front handle, rear motor enclosure and small upper cover. It is a complete supported carriage assembly rather than an isolated disc. Food, blade motion, cutting capability, hygiene or food-contact compliance, and electrical or mechanical-safety validation are not supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.631 × 0.635 × 0.606 m; 14,048 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
